title: Status backend
description: Self-reported health of the diagnosis backend, published retained on plant/{unit_id}/status/backend every few seconds and on every change. It says which decision backend is answering, how its calls are going and how much work is open; it never carries a prompt, a key or a decision payload.

backend.description: Which decision backend is selected and which model it calls.

model.description: Model identifier of the selected backend: the pinned decision-model version, the language-model identifier, or the version of the rule set.

decision.description: Counters over the decision calls since the backend started.

ok.description: Decision calls that returned an answer.

failed.description: Decision calls that ended in an error.

consecutive_errors.description: Errors since the last successful call; reset to 0 by a success.

last_ok_wall_ts.description: Wall-clock time of the last successful call, null before the first one.

last_error_wall_ts.description: Wall-clock time of the last failed call, null while none failed.

heartbeat.description: The two watchdogs of the backend, in the state they are in right now. A raised watchdog also publishes an alert-system message.

telemetry_silent.description: True while the simulator is playing and no telemetry sample has arrived within the timeout.

decision_api_silent.description: True while the decision API keeps failing and no call has succeeded since.

tickets_open.description: Tickets in the review or open state.

version.description: Version of the backend image or package that publishes this message.
